name: ObjexMT
description: ObjexMT is a benchmark for objective extraction and metacognitive calibration in multi-turn conversations, testing a model's ability to infer latent objectives and self-report confidence under challenging conditions such as multi-turn jailbreaks.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly serving as a research probe for objective inference and calibration in multi-turn settings.
notes: Uses LLM-judge semantic similarity converted to binary correctness; evaluates metacognition with multiple calibration metrics; dataset heterogeneity causes large accuracy variance.
